subject: Fix include order in custom_matchers.hpp to prevent min/max macro pollution (#4469)
reason: The change only reorders gmock/gtest #include directives in unit-test headers (src/unit/custom_matchers.hpp and src/unit/wrappers.h) to avoid min/max macro pollution when compiling the C++ unit tests. It is a build/test-infrastructure fix with no change to server, replication, persistence, command, or tool behaviour, so no runtime path exists for a scenario to exercise.
